items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: it's this cat Tommy, and he says, "Wilbur, I'm coming over. I'm gonna buy you a bass."

ctx.x: So we get down there and he says to pick one out, German and Czech so I'm checking out the basses, and I said to the salesman, 'How much do you want for that,' and he says $350 ... no, he says $450, and he says, 'Well, look, I'll give you $350 cash, and I say, 'Hold it, hold it,' you know, I say, 'This guy is nice enough to buy this and I know that we can go to the pawn shop and it wouldn't cost more than a hundred and some dollars.'

So I told him that and he said okay, you win. So I say, yeah, and we get in the car and we go out there to 47th and Prairie to Willis to a pawn shop Pond Shop, an outlet and they had a fiddle in there in an old [unintelligible] blonde case, and it didn't have no strings on it, naturally, and no cover, and I asked him how much he wanted for it, and he said, 'Oh, give me a hundred twenty-five' and Tommy said okay, and we went back downtown and got some strings, got a beautiful cover and a pick and the man fixed it…
